sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.
Commencing Alpha Route. Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear. Patrolling up Queen Street to maintain a strong security presence.
Welfare check along McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store and Mid City Shopping Centre, all clear. Maintaining standby to ensure a strong security presence.

Response call from Albert Mart Convenience Store reporting a female individual who walked in, took two pies and walked out without purchasing the items. She was with two other individuals who stood outside across the road from the store while she committed the theft; last seen heading down towards the Customs Street and Albert Street intersection. (Posted to Auror.) Making our way there to retrieve a photo description of the female.
Arrived at the response location, Albert Mart Convenience Store; photo retrieved and posted to Auror. (Photo on file.)
Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols down to the next checkpoint.
Arrived at the check-in at the Customs Street and Albert Street intersection; area thoroughly cleared, all clear.
Scoped out the Lower Albert bus terminal, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough completed within the area, commencing welfare checks on all stores, all clear.
Standing by to maintain a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Continuing patrols and making our presence visible along Queen Street.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, no issues or vagrants found, all clear.
Quick scope of Pocket Park and The Receptionist Cafe, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street, no issues found.
Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Wyndham Street, all clear.
Quick scope of Durham Street, no issues found.
Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Victoria Street; area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Quick scope of Darby Street for any encampment from street vagrants, all clear.

Welfare check along Remedy Coffee, all clear.

Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in, the last checkpoint for Alpha Route; full sweep completed with no issues or concerns identified. Standing by to ensure our presence is visible while awaiting response calls. Ending Alpha Route.
Welfare check along Munster Inn and Queens Food Court, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the top of Mayoral Drive; full scope of the area with no concerns visible.
Welfare check on the convenience stores along Cook Street and Upper Federal Street, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the top of Victoria Street; welfare checks commenced along all stores and businesses within the area, all clear. Standing by to maintain a strong security presence.
Continuing patrols, no activity requiring our assistance.
Patrolling down Albert Street ensuring our presence is known.
Welfare check completed along Natural Health, Good To Go Supermarket, Hollywood Bakery and Barclay's Suites, all clear.
Follow-up check along Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the Customs Street and Albert Street intersection, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Woolworths Metro and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in, the last checkpoint for Charlie Route. Ensuring our presence is known and strongly visible; remaining stationed here until further notice.

Response call from Hotel Indigo reporting a group of vagrants being loud in St Patrick's Square near Federal Square. As the individuals were on public ground and not in front of the business, we advised that we cannot forcefully move them along as they have a right to be on public grounds, but that we would make our way over to ensure our presence is visible.

Arrived at the response location, Hotel Indigo; the group of vagrants had already moved along without further issues. Advised the business that our service is to help when there are issues within the store or when individuals are obstructing business on the property, and that if the group returns we will happily speak with them to keep the volume down.
Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols and making our way to HQ for morning interval.
Arrived at Mid City; taking our morning interval.
Morning interval concluded. Ending Charlie Route.
Commencing Delta Route. Arrived at the check-in at the corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Auckland Library, all clear.
Welfare check along Nandos, Munster Inn and Queens Food Court, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the top of Mayoral Drive; full scope of the area, all clear.

Arrived at the Aotea Square check-in; walkthrough completed around the location, welfare check completed along Aotea Centre and Jack's Fried Chicken, all clear. Standing by to ensure our presence is visible while awaiting further response calls.
Welfare checks completed along Metro Entertainment City, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at Elliott Street Apartment and Elliott Stables, all clear.
Welfare check within Atrium on Elliott and the food court, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear.
Welfare check completed along the train station on Victoria Street and the static guard, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the top of Victoria Street; standing by stationed here to ensure no issues are occurring while maintaining our presence.
Response call from Ippondo Queen Street reporting an individual smoking what smells to be cannabis in front of their store.
Arrived at the response location, Ippondo; asked the group of individuals to move along due to the complaints raised by the store. They complied shortly after without further issues.
Arrived at HQ; taking lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:44)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radio, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Swipe Key.
Response message regarding a female being erratic, yelling and causing a public disturbance outside Chemist Warehouse Queen Street.

Arrived at the location at Chemist Warehouse Queen Street; the female, who appears to be mentally unwell and intoxicated, was yelling and screaming in public. Advised her to put the alcohol away as public drinking is prohibited, and to keep her volume down due to the complaints about her yelling. She was compliant and calmed down; standing by in case she starts yelling again.
Departing the standby area; no issues have occurred.

Arrived outside Faradays Queen Street; welfare checks on stores within the area, all clear, no issues reported. Standing by for security presence towards members of the public and surrounding businesses, and for any nearby response calls.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred and no nearby response calls.
Arrived at Fort Street; welfare checks on stores within the area.
Welfare checks on the Fort Street stores complete; no issues reported. Standing by for security presence for the surrounding businesses.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred within the area and no response calls received.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare checks on stores within the area.
Welfare checks on stores within the area complete; none of the stores have anything to report. Standing by on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred and no response calls received.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street West; welfare checks on stores along Albert Street and Victoria Street West, all clear, no issues reported.
Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred within the area.

Arrived at the Elliott Street check-in; welfare checks on stores on Darby Street and Elliott Street, all clear, no issues. Standing by on Elliott Street for security presence and nearby response calls.

Response call from Typo Queen Street regarding a female individual who stole from their store. Description: black backpack, long black hair, all-black clothing, green jumper tied around her waist; last seen heading up High Street on a Lime scooter. Making our way over to High Street.
Arrived at High Street; commencing a full sweep down to Shortland Street.

Arrived at Shortland Street; full sweep of High Street, Chancery Square, Freyberg Square and O'Connell Street completed with no sighting of the individual from Typo. Heading back to Typo to get a photo of the individual.
The store manager informed us the photos will be sent through to our WhatsApp, as the boss needs to be contacted to release the footage.
Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone due to low percentage.

Arrived at HQ; noticed a female vagrant outside our office smoking near the no-smoking sign. Asked her to move along and she complied with no issues. Standing by outside HQ as she is still within the area, in case she returns.

Response call from Mobile Doctors regarding the same male vagrant who regularly stands outside their store disturbing members of the public; he has returned and assistance was requested to move him along.
Arrived at Mobile Doctors; informed the male he had to leave and he complied, with no issues to report. Standing by in case he returns.
Heading back to HQ to commence floor checks.
Arrived outside McDonald's Queen Street; welfare checks on stores within the area, all clear, no issues. Standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred within the area and no nearby response calls.
Arrived at the Lorne Street fountain; welfare checks on stores within the area, all clear, no issues reported. Standing by for any nearby response calls while maintaining a heavy security presence.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at Freyberg Square / Chancery Square; welfare checks on stores within the area complete, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane; welfare checks on stores, all clear, nothing to report.
Arrived at the Mills Lane check-in, all clear.
Arrived at the Albert Street check-in, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street and Victoria Street West; standing by for any nearby response calls or problematic issues or vagrants that may occur within the area.
Leaving the standby area; no issues occurred within the area and no response calls received.
Arrived at Aotea Square; standing by on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area, with welfare checks on stores within the area.
Leaving the standby area; no issues to be reported.
Arrived outside Avachi Queen Street; standing by maintaining our security presence for members of the public and surrounding businesses.
Leaving the standby area; no issues to be reported.
Arrived at TK Square; welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Leaving the standby area; no issues to be reported. Heading back to HQ for a 30-minute meal break.
Arrived at HQ for a 30-minute meal break.
Response call from 28 Shortland Street regarding an intoxicated female individual; assistance requested to remove her from the premises.
Arrived at 28 Shortland Street; the store manager identified the individual. We informed her she had to leave the premises at the manager's request and she complied with us, no issues.
Currently standing by with the female as paramedics have been called due to her mental health and condition.
Afternoon shift concluded late due to the ongoing response call.

flags: SENSITIVE: 02:35 Bar 101 — guards physically separated two males during an altercation in which one threatened to fight the other; both parties left the area, no injuries reported. Low-level physical intervention (not Commercial Bay, not the Reign & Pour matter).

QA: Night Shift opening timestamps out of order in the raw ('11:02pm' note followed by '22:26') — normalised to 23:02/23:26 as the paramedic standby continued past 23:00; medical incident (28 Shortland Street female) spans the Afternoon and Night shifts and is counted once.
